open.label: Say no thanks to a recap of The Cartographer's Silence at 4:03:17

steps.say: Decline the recap offer on The Cartographer's Silence (cs-1) with No thanks, just play. Until the host lands the JWT library, the service refuses every bearer token by design (research R-2) and this step records 401; once it does, the step records 404 until LB3's import has written a BookImported for this listener on book-cs-1, then 422 { error: noOpenOffer } until CU2's offer has written a RecapOffered on catch-up-cs-1, and 200 { bookId, position, offeredAt, declinedAt } after that.

Say no thanks again: a second decline of the same offer answers exactly as the first did, with the first declinedAt ({declinedAt}), and records nothing new — an offer is answered at most once (R2, D61).
